cases.question: 保单总数是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ins_policy

cases.question: 按保单状态统计保单数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ins_policy GROUP BY status

cases.question: 按区域统计保单数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ins_policy GROUP BY region

cases.question: 华东的保费合计是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT SUM(premium) AS total_premium FROM ins_policy WHERE region = '华东'

cases.question: 按区域统计保费合计，并按保费从高到低排列
cases.goldSql: SELECT region, SUM(premium) AS total_premium FROM ins_policy GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_premium DESC

cases.question: 按客户等级统计保单数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT c.cust_level, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ins_policy p JOIN ins_customer c ON p.cust_id = c.id GROUP BY c.cust_level

cases.question: 2025 年生效的保单保费合计是多少？
cases.goldSql: SELECT SUM(premium) AS total_premium FROM ins_policy WHERE YEAR(effect_date) = 2025

cases.question: 2025 年生效且状态为生效的保单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ins_policy WHERE YEAR(effect_date) = 2025 AND status = '生效'

cases.question: 状态为退保的保单有多少张？
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ins_policy WHERE status = '退保'
